description: This PHP class 'JobCategoryService' provides methods for managing job categories, including retrieving, saving, deleting, and normalizing job category data within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: JobCategoryService
classes.description: Service class for managing job categories, providing CRUD operations and normalization.

methods.name: getJobCategoryDao
methods.description: Returns the JobCategoryDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: setJobCategoryDao
methods.description: Sets the JobCategoryDao instance for this service.

methods.name: getJobCategoryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job categories with optional sorting, pagination, and count.

methods.name: getJobCategoryById
methods.description: Fetches a specific JobCategory by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Saves a JobCategory entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteJobCategory
methods.description: Deletes job categories by their IDs.

methods.name: getJobCategoryArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized job category data.
